title: Wizard and Skeletal Figure
description: A wizard in a red hat stands holding a glowing orb, looking down at a skeletal figure lying in a wheat field with glowing mushrooms growing from its bones. Floating islands with trees and structures hover in the starry night sky above.
prompt: A bearded wizard wearing a tall red pointed hat, green tunic and white sleeves stands in a golden wheat field at night, holding up a glowing glass orb in one hand while gesturing with the other, looking down at a dark-skinned woman with long black hair lying peacefully on the ground, her body merged with a black skeleton from which glowing green mushrooms are sprouting, several floating islands with trees and ancient structures drifting in the starry night sky with a shooting star, detailed fantasy illustration
